title: AreBelong roster publication index
description: Edit roster.json to propose hero packages. Array order is roster and inspector order. Cross-field uniqueness and featured references are checked by npm run validate:roster.

id.description: Stable public URL identifier; preserve it for package updates.

cid.description: Bare lowercase base32 CIDv1, dag-pb, sha2-256. Directory must contain manifest.json. No gateway URL or file path.

featured.description: Three existing hero IDs, in stage order. Select published packages with models and idle animations.
